turns.text: Hi there. I'd like to swap my flight on Saturday, if that's okay.
Of course. Can I have your booking code and last name?
Thank you, Ms. Adams. I see Dubai to London SK214 on Saturday at 23:55, Economy. Which flight would you like instead?
The earlier one, the 08:10 on Saturday. SK210.

SK210 leaves Dubai for London at 08:10 on Saturday, and there are seats. Your booking was made less than 24 hours ago, so there is no change fee. The fare difference is $30, since SK210 is $410 and your current fare is $380.
Okay. And do I pay anything else? Like a fee?
No fee, just the $30 difference. Would you like me to make the change?
Done. Booking FF9N2Q is now SK210 Dubai to London on Saturday at 08:10, with the $30 fare difference charged. Anything else I can help with?
